data.text: Kenya National Highways Authority (KeNHA) has issued a traffic advisory for the Rironi-Nakuru-Mau Summit (A8) highway. On November 28, 2025, President William Ruto will launch the dual carriageway project, causing full-day congestion. Motorists are urged to reschedule or use alternate routes like Ngong-Suswa-Narok or Nairobi-Thika-Magumu.

Traffic Advisory 

In connection with the closure of Palam Railway Crossing for 03 months (w.e.f. 03.11.2025) due to ongoing construction work, traffic movement in the surrounding areas will remain affected. Commuters are requested to plan their travel accordingly.

📍 TRAFFIC DIVERSION ROUTES:
* Dwarka → Delhi Cantt./Dhaula Kuan: Use Palam–Dwarka Flyover.
* Manglapuri → Delhi Cantt./Dhaula Kuan: Take Parshuram Chowk → Palam Flyover.
* Palam Colony → Palam Flyover Road: Use alternate routes via Parshuram Chowk / Manglapuri / Bhagat Chandra Hospital Chowk.
* Heavy Vehicles: Avoid the Palam area; follow Ring Road / NH-48.

📍 PUBLIC ADVISORY:
* Avoid the affected stretches & opt for alternative routes.
* Prefer public transport to reduce congestion.
* Follow instructions of traffic personnel for smooth movement.

ZERO REPORT — NOV 26, 2025
Global Volcanic Synchronization Phase

The last 72 hours locked in what we’ve been tracking for months: the Earth system is releasing pressure through volcanic vents instead of major fault ruptures. When locked plates refuse to break, the mantle finds the fastest escape valves. That’s exactly what’s happening.

The sequence:
1.Hayli Gubbi, Afar Rift — first recorded eruption in human history.
Ash column to 45,000 ft.
A new fissure system opened inside the thinnest continental crust on the planet.
2.Semeru, Indonesia — sudden explosive burst with no meaningful precursors.
3.Taal, Philippines — phreatomagmatic pulse and new plume rise.
4.Popocatépetl, Mexico — sustained high-output degassing and ash discharge.
5.Bezymianny, Kamchatka — 33,000 ft eruption column punching out of the Pacific Plate subduction arc.

Six major volcanic centers across four tectonic regimes erupting in the same window. Rift, arc, hotspot, subduction. The pattern is global, not regional.

The common thread: internal pressure rebalancing.
ZeroKey is peaking.
The faults are locked.
The mantle is unloading vertically.

The Afar eruption was the real marker. A dormant shield in a triple-junction rift does not blow a 45,000-ft column unless deeper structures have begun opening. That’s a tectonic pressure valve, not random activity.

The magnetic and seismic data match the pattern: elevated noise, minor swarming, no large ruptures, and a multi-day scalar drift signature showing internal torque redistribution. This is what the system looks like when something big wants to break but the crust hasn’t failed yet.

Right now the planet is venting through every weak point it can find.
That’s why we’re seeing eruptions across the Ring of Fire, the East African Rift, and the Mediterranean arc simultaneously.

This is not over. The next window runs through early December. The release mode will either stay volcanic or transition to tectonic. Either way, the system is moving.
